about: A Pokemon that transforms into one with the same ability does not start it again (Showdown's setAbility for a transformation starts the ability only when it differs, from the fifth generation): a Gyarados with Intimidate that transforms into an Intimidate Gyarados intimidates once, as it comes in. A level-20 Gyarados is given Transform (teach:) against a forced wild Gyarados that knows only Splash. "The wild Gyarados’s Attack fell!" once, as the two come in. Before, every entry flag cleared, it intimidated the wild one a second time after the Transform. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
